findings.summary: `createBrowserErrorEvent` is exported but has no production caller.
findings.consequence: The module keeps a full event-builder path, including hashing and full generated event assembly, even though the runtime reporter now captures compact intake events directly. This leaves extra public surface that tests depend on but production code does not exercise.
findings.evidence: `rg -n "createBrowserErrorEvent" -S .` shows references only at the function definition and in `test/unit/observability-browser.spec.ts`; `app/plugins/observability.client.ts` imports `BrowserObservabilityReporter` and calls `reporter.capture`, not this helper.
findings.recommendation: Delete the exported helper if no external package consumes it, and move any remaining full-event fixture construction into the unit test file or a test-only helper. Keep production capture paths on `BrowserObservabilityReporter.capture`/`enqueue`.
